spec.kitLine: After 100 normal atks: Elem Adv Dmg +30.23%/3s
spec.assertion: buffApply stat elemAdvantageDamagePct, value 30.23, targetSlug === rei only, finite short expiry, >=5 re-applications over 180s. Plus a 10x value scale that must be EXACTLY damage-inert (rei Fire vs Fire boss = no advantage). RED under: MISSING line (0 events), a generic attackDamagePct/elementDamagePct mis-stat (the 10x scale would raise damage), an allies-broadcast target, or a passive/start-of-battle trigger (single application).

Removing the flatDamage costs >1% of her total (line is live and non-trivial); re-keying its block to shotFired more than doubles her total (proves the 100-hit gate, RED under a per-shot trigger); teammates byte-identical (inertness).

Forcing crit:false LOSES damage (faithful riders crit at the caster rate); forcing core:true GAINS damage (kit says no core strike, so faithful is core-free — equality would mean core:true shipped); all srcSlot 'skill1' damage events have rangeApplied false.

spec.kitLine: Start of battle: Dmg to Shield +700.5% cont.
spec.assertion: it.skip — StatKey has no shield-damage member and the v1 boss carries no shield pool, so the line is unobservable end-to-end. Belongs in `unmodeled`, not a block.

spec.kitLine: Enter Burst stage 3: ATK +25.03% of user ATK
spec.assertion: Differencing casterAtkPct buffApply values against a run with the effect removed isolates exactly ONE new value V; V is a flat-resolved ATK number (>100, not 25.03) — RED under the 'ATK ▲x%' -> atkPct mis-encoding, which emits no casterAtkPct at all. count(V) === fullBurstStart count — RED under a burstCast/own-burst keying, which can only fire on the rotations she casts (the second Burst III in the fixture is what separates them). targetSlug set === {rei} (Fire-only).

Broadening target to all allies raises the non-Fire teammates' summed damage (element scoping is load-bearing, not decorative); stretching durationSec 10 -> 60 raises her total — RED under a permanent/continuous mis-encoding, where a 60s cap would instead remove uptime.

spec.kitLine: Fire allies: Shield 13.44% caster Max HP/10s
spec.assertion: The removal variant must succeed (ok===true), which asserts a `shield` effect actually exists on the burst slot (no silent drop); removing it changes NOTHING (her total and every teammate byte-identical) — RED if the shield were mis-encoded as an offensive stat grant. Magnitude itself is it.skip'd: no HP pool, no `shielded`-trigger consumer in the control comp.

buffApply attackDamagePct with the RAW 48.02 percentage (plain stats are not flat-resolved), targetSlug set === {rei}, count <= stage-3 entries (own-burst keyed subset). Removing it loses damage; durationSec 10 -> 60 gains damage (real window, not permanent); target -> all allies raises teammates (Fire scoping load-bearing).

Removing it costs >1% of her total; srcSlot 'burst' damage events (read on the helm=false fixture so they are attributable) number 1..fullBursts and every one carries fbMajorApplied false and rangeApplied false — pins the burst-cast FB-exemption and the no-range convention. RED if the nuke were modelled as an FB-window rider that picks up the +50% major.

fixtures: controlComp('rei-ayanami', true) = liter B1 / crown B2 / rei-ayanami B3 / helm B3 vs the Fire boss for every buff/total assertion — B1+B2 are mandatory (a lone Burst III casts nothing and the fight makes ZERO Full Bursts), and helm is kept deliberately as a SECOND Burst III because that is what makes 'entering Burst stage 3' (any stage-3 entry) separable from an own-burst keying. A second hoisted run with helm=false is used ONLY where damage events are attributed by srcSlot (helm's burst also emits srcSlot 'burst'; liter's and crown's bursts carry no damage effects). Note the fixture's boss is Fire and rei-ayanami is Fire, so she has NO elemental advantage — S1a's magnitude is unobservable here, which the test converts into an inertness discriminator rather than skipping. 16 hoisted runs total; all counterfactuals via withPatchedOverride (committed JSON untouched) with throw-on-not-found patch helpers so a MISSING kit line fails a named assertion instead of passing silently.
gaps: skill2 'Damage dealt to Shield ▲700.5% continuously' — it.skip: no shield-damage StatKey primitive and the v1 boss has no shield pool; unobservable end-to-end, belongs in `unmodeled`.

burst 'Shield equal to 13.44% of the skill user's final Max HP for 10 sec' MAGNITUDE — it.skip: no HP pool modelled and no ally in the control comp carries a `shielded` trigger, so only the effect's EXISTENCE and its total inertness are assertable, not its size.

S1a 'Elemental Advantage Attack Damage ▲30.23%' MAGNITUDE — measurement-gated on this fixture: carrier element === boss element means zero elemental advantage, so only the buffApply structure (stat/value/target/window/cadence) plus damage-inertness can be pinned; the damage contribution needs a comp where the boss element is disadvantaged vs Fire.

⚑ MG cadence (pulls/sec) is not in the kit prose and rate_of_fire is a known-unreliable datamine field, so the absolute proc count of both 100-hit lines is not assertable — every hit-count assertion is written comparatively (base vs counterfactual) rather than against an absolute expected proc count.
